description: Returns every different English word from all lists whose grade range includes a grade, deduplicated, each with the ids of the lists it comes from, plus totalDifferentWords and returned. Words come in dataset list order and are cut at limit (no offset or paging). Use this for a grade-wide pool; use get_word_list for one specific list, or find_words to search by letter pattern. A grade is a typical guide, not a rule: programs and standards differ, and it is not an assessment of any child. English lists are placed by grade; lists in other languages follow each language's own curriculum and have no grade.

grade.description: Required grade: pre-k, kindergarten, grade-1, grade-2 or grade-3.

limit.description: Maximum words to return, 1 to 1500. Default 300; compare returned with totalDifferentWords to see if the result was cut.

section.description: Only lists in this section, e.g. sight or cvc. wordlist (other languages) gives no words here. Omit for all sections.

name: get_words_for_grade
title: Words for a grade
